---
title: "All of Statistics — Solutions"
---

My worked solutions to the exercises in Larry Wasserman's
*All of Statistics: A Concise Course in Statistical Inference*.

I add solutions chapter by chapter as I work through the book. Each chapter
lives on its own page; problems are numbered to match the textbook.

## Chapters

| [2](chapter02.qmd) | Probability | In progress |

## How this site is organized

- Each chapter is a single `.qmd` file (e.g. `chapter02.qmd`).
- The [chapter template](template.qmd) shows the formatting conventions
  (math, proofs, code, figures) — copy/paste from it when starting a new
  problem or chapter.

::: {.callout-note}
Solutions are my own attempts and may contain errors. Corrections welcome via
the repo.
:::
